title: CONCATENATEX sorts ascending when an order expression has no direction
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", CONCATENATEX ( Product, Product[Product], "|", Product[Price] ) )

source.quote: The default order is ASC (ascending) when OrderBy_Expression argument is present and the corresponding Order argument is not specified.
This is the default value when the order parameter is omitted.

derivation: Prices: Bike 100, Helmet 20, Lock 10, Scooter 50. Ascending by price: Lock, Helmet, Scooter, Bike.
notes: The default differs from TOPN and RANKX, which default to descending.
